sections.content: A loop inside a loop processes combinations — rows and columns, every pair of items, or repeated patterns. The inner loop completes fully for each outer iteration.
Nested loops multiply work: an outer loop of N and inner of M runs the inner body N×M times. Keep nesting shallow for speed and clarity.
Key points: inner loop variables must differ from outer ones, and indentation makes nesting visible at a glance.
